items.title: Gap Mangione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: Well I decided to write a kind of Stevie

ctx.x: I do too and sometimes you have to be careful that you don’t start writing something that’s not friendly to the instrument.
Or to the players. I remember not that long ago the “Family Holidays” CD that we did has a track called “The Christmas Waltz.” Well I decided to write a kind of Stevie

Wonder “Sir Duke” shout chorus for that. It had a lot of notes. And the computer did it just fine. We got to the recording session and it took a while, but that’s about the only rehearsal that we’ve ever had with the band. The rest of the time, I mean these guys are really such honchos, the guys in the band.
